title: misandra juncea
intro: Misandra juncea, commonly known as Yellow Myrtle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae, native to India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as its use in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Misandra juncea are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Misandra juncea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
